title: A Phase 2, Placebo-Controlled, Randomized, Double-Blind Study of 2 Doses of Crofelemer for the Treatment of adult patients with Short Bowel Syndrome and Intestinal Failure (SBS-IF) without colon in continuity (CIC).

Main objective: Assess the safety and tolerability of crofelemer in adult patients with Short Bowel Syndrome with Intestinal Failure (SBS-IF) without colon-in-continuity (CIC).
Evaluate the preliminary efficacy of crofelemer in adult patients with Short Bowel Syndrome with Intestinal Failure (SBS-IF) without colon-in-continuity (CIC).
